clips.title: The story
paras: At Loch Modan’s Southern Gate, Captain Rugelfuss faces a growing trogg threat with too few defenders. The Ironforge Reserve has been called away to support Alliance battlefronts, leaving the remaining garrison stretched thin. Rugelfuss asks travelers to thin the troggs in the hills and bring back their stone teeth.

Captain Rugelfuss guards Loch Modan’s southern approach with only a small garrison. The dwarven mountaineers and Ironforge Reserve have been sent to reinforce Alliance battlefronts, leaving the Southern Gate guard tower short of troops. Rugelfuss is under strict orders to hold the gate, so he cannot lead an attack into the highlands. Nearby settlers and travelers remain exposed to ambushes.

Troggs in the nearby crags threaten Khaz Modan, and their numbers grow quickly when left unchecked. They could overrun dwarven outposts. To buy time and thin their ranks, Rugelfuss asks travelers to strike at the troggs in their hillside warrens and bring back their stone teeth as proof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Adventurer, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands. With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe. My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.
But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills. If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs. Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me? If not, there is still work to be done, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am quite impressed, friend. You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands. King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
